doc.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Interviewer's appreciation of the live TV stories
summary: Rowe thanks Hardaway and says he had never heard the inside story of live TV.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well I’ve been fascinated to talk to you and get the inside scoop on some of this stuff I haven’t heard before.
Well I hope something was of some interest perhaps.
That’s the first time I heard kind of the inside story about live T.V. and all that, it’s really great.
